content.value: Automobiles arrive at the exit of Khan Jahan Ali Bridge at the rate of two per (12) minute. The distribution of arrivals approximates a Poisson distribution.
(i) What is the probability that no automobiles arrives in a particular minute?
(ii) What is the probability that at least one automobiles arrives during a particular minute?
